test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution: The correct answer is **efforts** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct filler to be used in option 5 is efforts.​​ • The word effort means, 'something that is done with difficulty or that takes a lot of energy (**कठिनाई से या बहुत शक्ति लगाकर किया जाने वाला काम**)' • Ex: *It was a real **effort** to stay awake during the lecture.* • The sentence of the cloze test containing blank (5) tells the need of serious **efforts** to imbibe proper road culture in public. *Therefore, the correct answer is option 3).* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • The Government is taking seriously the (1) issue__ of road safety and is committed to reducing the number of people killed in accidents. Forums are being conducted (2) __regularly__ to bring law-makers, law enforcement officers and road users together to discuss ways to (3) __tackle__ the rise in road accidents. Everyone agrees that more needs to be done on road safety in its determination to (4) __curb__ the rate of road accidents in the country. The Government, with the cooperation of relevant agencies, is making serious (5) **__efforts__** to instil proper road culture in children, young adults and the public in general. 50:T55f, The pattern followed here is:
